title: Ronga 2021 · Passive EEG pilot
citation: Ronga et al. (2021). Seeming confines: Electrophysiological evidence of peripersonal space remapping following tool-use in humans. Cortex, 144, 133–150.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.sound: Two fixed near/far loudspeakers, less than 5 cm and 145 cm from the stimulated hand. Nominal 50 ms, 784 Hz tones.
published_method.touch: 200 µs DS7A square pulse at twice the participant’s perception threshold, to the dorsum of the right hand.
published_method.timing: Tactile event is nominal time zero for paired trials; sound starts 40 ms after it. Auditory-alone and tactile-alone trials anchor to their sole event. Publication reports randomized 7000–9000 ms ITIs.
published_method.allocation: Five conditions (T, ANear, AFar, TANear, TAFar), 24 trials each per assessment in two blocks.
published_method.sound_level: Equal nominal output amplitude for the two speakers.
published_method.response: Attend to touch without a motor response. Use the tactile and auditory alone waveforms in the near and far superadditivity contrasts.

stimulus_type.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

source_provenance.gap: Waveform files specific to the passive EEG pilot are unverified.

renderer_or_apparatus.gap: Speaker model, angular coordinates, channel routing, calibration reference and stimulus-loop latency unspecified.

condition_intermixing.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption
condition_intermixing.gap: Exact condition sequence and balancing within each block unspecified.

iti_jitter_policy.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption
iti_jitter_policy.gap: No distribution, steps or precise onset/offset clock specified.

task_sequence_rules.value: Attend to touch and ignore sound. No motor response required.

value.threshold_reference: twice individual detection threshold measured by method of limits before each session

tactile_stimulus.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

soa_table.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

baseline_strategy.value: Record T, ANear and AFar separately. At each location, subtract summed unimodal ERP waveforms from the corresponding paired ERP.

baseline_timing.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption
baseline_timing.gap: No sound in T trials, so no within-trial audio-relative SOA.

catch_trial_type.value: ANear and AFar are unimodal EEG reference conditions in the passive task. No behavioral catch scoring.

catch_count.gap: Two auditory-only EEG reference conditions × 24. No behavioral catches.

implementation_gaps: Requires fixed loudspeaker routing and synchronized, individually calibrated electrical stimulation. The original sound files and delivered timing are unavailable.
Requires synchronized EEG markers, acquisition and passive-trial processing, along with the original programmed ITI distribution and order.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
